'''Mrlsst''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Freeworlds Territory]] on the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mrlssi]] and a voting member of the [[League of Tapani Freeworlds]].

==Characteristics==
Mrlsst was the only planet in the sector with an indigenous [[Alien/Legends|alien]] race. It was a moist and humid world, with terrain dominated by marshes and sandy swamps. Nearly everywhere, one could find the towering [[greenstalk]] plants that grew all over the planet, except the poles.

[[File:Mrlsst3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mrlsst Landscape (around Academy Main Hall).]]

A thick [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid field]] surrounded the planet, which was used for raw materials and was the location of several research stations.

Mrlsst was the home of the famous [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy]], the best university in the sector, and one of the best beyond the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
The first contact between the Mrlssi and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] occurred sometime before [[7000 BBY]]. Mrlsst joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] shortly thereafter. [[Canny Mandary Bertar]] represented the planet in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and after the Republic was reorganized into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|the first Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

Thousands of years ago, the planet's continents were unstable, resulting in frequent groundquakes and tidal waves; the natives became used to losing possessions amidst such disasters, and came to appreciate knowledge as a result. The planet had grown much more stable by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but the tradition of learning endured among the Mrlssi.

It was while en route to Mrlssi that the [[Margrave Octan]]'s colonial transport from the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], the ''[[Sun Runner]]'', vanished c. [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], when it attempted to make a supply run from the nearby [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nallastia]] only a week after the colonists arrived on the [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]]. The ship and its three precious power gems—known thereafter as the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]]—were not found in subsequent searches until [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], when, in fulfillment of an ancient deathbed [[Force vision/Legends|prophecy]], they were discovered by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], with the help of the [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]], a descendant of the [[Royal Octans]] of the Darpa sector.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Daakman Barrek]] hailed from Mrlsst.

[[File:Bombing_Mrlsst.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] bombing Mrlsst.]]

Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet was the site of a [[Mission to Mrlsst|battle]] between [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Loka Hask]] for the control of [[Phantom Project]], a new [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] technology. Hask was eventually defeated, but the planet suffered heavy casualities.<ref name="XWRS:TPA" />
